items.job: Replace HID headlight bulb or ballast
items.note: Price is per side. Toyota's old headlight coverage has ended; ask a dealer about your car's history.

items.job: Replace head gasket and clean EGR system
items.note: Many owners pick a used or rebuilt engine instead. Cost rises a lot if overheating damaged the engine.

items.job: Clean EGR valve, cooler and intake manifold
items.note: New gaskets are needed. If the EGR cooler or valve must be replaced, parts cost more.
Often covered by Toyota's inverter recall or extended coverage. Check your VIN. Used inverters cost less.

items.t: Brake booster pump noise or failure
items.note: Toyota extended coverage on this part for many cars. Check your VIN with a dealer before paying.

items.job: Replace electric engine water pump and refill coolant

items.note: Rebuilt or remanufactured packs cost less than new. Some cars may still be under hybrid battery warranty.

items.t: Power steering assist can drop out from loose steering nuts (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 11V-304. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Hybrid system can stall instead of going into limp mode (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 20V-369. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Engine wire harness can rub through and short (recall)
items.job: Inspect engine wire harness and add protective sleeve
items.note: Free under recall 18V-579. Check the VIN first. Harness is replaced if damaged.

items.t: Parking brake cable can come off its lever (recall)
items.job: Install parking brake cable retaining clips
items.note: Free under recall 16V-741. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Passenger airbag can partly inflate on its own (recall)
items.note: Free under recall 16V-672. Check the VIN first.

items.t: Rear door can open on its own from a wet door switch (recall)
items.job: Modify rear door opener switch circuits
items.note: Free under recall 26V-049. Check the VIN first.
